key_insight: DreamStream focuses on making driving simulation faithful to the policy’s needs, not just visually realistic. It aims to preserve the scene features an end-to-end driving policy uses for decisions, enabling more trustworthy evaluation in closed loop.
problem_solved: Current driving simulators often have a sim-to-real visual gap that distorts policy perception, making it hard to accurately evaluate how an end-to-end driving policy will behave in the real world.
method: Build a generative, closed-loop simulator designed for policy-oriented fidelity rather than only photo-realism.
Use simulator-grounded generation to preserve decision-relevant scene structure and cues that driving policies depend on.
Support closed-loop evaluation so the policy’s own actions influence future simulated observations, better reflecting real driving dynamics.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this offers a stronger evaluation environment for end-to-end driving models, reducing false confidence caused by realistic-looking but policy-misaligned simulations. It can improve benchmarking, debugging, and safer deployment of autonomous driving systems.

paper_title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
paper_authors: Ziyang Leng, Sicheng Mo, Seth Z. Zhao, Haoyuan Cai, Yu Zeng
